summary: SSR Mining Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an Arrangement Agreement dated October 13, 2026, under which its BC unlimited liability subsidiary will acquire all outstanding Roxmore Resources Inc. shares for C$6.75 per share in cash via a BC plan of arrangement. SSR will indirectly receive a 14.99% stake in newly created SpinCo, which holds Roxmore's Rattlesnake Hills, Shabu River and Newton properties, funded with US$10.0 million; former Roxmore securityholders retain 85.01%. Closing requires 66 2/3% securityholder approval, MI 61-101 majority-of-minority approval, BC Supreme Court approval, and dissent under 10%. Watch regulatory and court timing plus dissent levels; cash consideration leaves no financing or stock-overhang risk.
